name: process_notify_policy
label: Set the Process to Reference the Notification Policy Table
description: The process settings reference the notification policy table, which can be used for related queries in process-related reports.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: notify_policy_id
fields.description: Notification strategy ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_uuid field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_notify_policy_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the notify_policy_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
